payload.content: A B2B risk, compliance and certification WordPress website helping organisations distinguish ISAE, ISO, information-security and control services before moving to a quickscan or consultation.
payload.description_1: Business clients may know they face a compliance, audit or control requirement without knowing whether ISAE, ISO, risk management or another framework applies. Dense specialist terminology could make those routes harder to distinguish before an advisory conversation begins.
payload.description_2: I separated risk management, compliance, certification and control topics into recognisable service routes, supported by quickscan and consultation actions. Recruitment and IT-detachering content remain available for a second audience without competing with the primary advisory journey. This keeps technical detail available without making the first decision dependent on specialist terminology.
